extraction_notes: Source PDF SHA-256 b0bb64c3af922943a9399cda1e7630936c7637b91c3d097d375050b2ad69eba1 verified before extraction.
Extraction method: pdftotext -layout for tables plus pdftoppm 400 dpi renders of p.3 and p.4 figures for manual curve digitization.

P-channel sign convention: the datasheet quotes VDS, VGS, ID, VSD and BVDSS as negative values and the figures plot -VDS/-VGS/-ID/-VSD/-IS axes; all values and curve points here are stored as magnitudes per the mosfet context pack, with the original signed datasheet form recorded in each conditions string.

Digitized curve consistency checks: Fig 8 reads at -VDS = 15 V (Ciss ~2040 pF, Coss ~340 pF, Crss ~305 pF) match the p.2 table typicals (2050/330/300 pF); Fig 6 25 degC read of ~0.74 V at 1 A matches the p.2 VSD TYP of -0.7 V; Fig 1 VGS = -10 V slope (~12 mOhm at high current) is consistent with the 9.5 mOhm TYP RDS(ON) at -14 A rising with drain current per Fig 3.
Transfer curve (Fig 2) digitized from the 25 degC trace at VDS = -5 V; the 125 degC trace crosses it near 40 A and was not digitized.
Digitization uncertainty is roughly one half minor gridline: about +/-2 A on Figs 1-2, +/-30 pF on Fig 8, +/-0.02 V on Fig 6.
Gate charge Qg(10V) TYP 40 nC / MAX 60 nC and Qgs 6 nC / Qgd 10 nC at VGS = -10 V, VDS = -15 V, ID = -14 A (p.2); Fig 7 endpoint read of ~38 nC at |VGS| = 10 V is consistent with the 40 nC typical.
Body diode reverse recovery: trr TYP 14 ns, Qrr TYP 25 nC at IF = -14 A, di/dt = 500 A/us (p.2).
Gate resistance Rg TYP 3.2 Ohm, MAX 6.4 Ohm at f = 1 MHz (p.2).
Thermal: RthJA 40 degC/W MAX (t <= 10 s), 75 degC/W MAX steady-state, RthJL 24 degC/W MAX (p.1).
IDSS MAX -1 uA at VDS = -30 V, VGS = 0 V (TJ = 25 degC), -5 uA at TJ = 55 degC; gate leakage +/-100 nA MAX at VGS = +/-25 V (p.2).
No vendor SPICE model or model pack was used; all evidence is from the public AOS datasheet Rev.1.0 November 2019.
